# ClickUp

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Public pages captured signed out. Signed-in screens were not captured..

Captured 2026-11-22, signed out (public pages only; login, signup, checkout, and subscribe were not followed). Themes: light.

ClickUp is a work management product. This package is the public marketing site at [https://clickup.com/](https://clickup.com/), captured signed out on 2026-11-22. Themes: light only. Widths: 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844. No account was used. Login and signup were photographed empty and then stopped.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

Body background computed transparent. The page colour `#ffffff` is `--Core-Background-Main`, not a painted body fill.

The hero computed weight 700. The declared `--text-display-2xl` weight is 650. Both are recorded. The token uses the computed weight.

Sign Up computed `rgba(32, 32, 32, 0.8)`. The token stores the opaque ink `#202020` from Get Started and `--Core-Button-Primary`.

Purple `#6647f0` is `--Core-Accents-Purple`. The primary marketing button is ink, not purple.

The homepage product panel is a marketing illustration. Names in it are sample copy. It is not a signed-in inbox.

No dark theme was painted. `color-scheme` on the homepage was `normal`.

The login button fill `#bbbbbb` is the disabled state while both fields are empty.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do paint the page white and the text near-black.** Page is `#ffffff`. Text is `#202020`. See [home-light-1440](screenshots/home-light-1440.png).
2. **Do set the hero in Plus Jakarta Sans.** The heading is 60px, weight 700, letter-spacing -2.1px. Same shot.
3. **Do make the primary action an ink button.** Get Started is `#202020` with white text and a 12px radius. Same shot.
4. **Do keep Login as a light grey pill.** Login is `#f0f0f0` with black text and an 8px radius.
5. **Don't treat the purple accent as the primary button.** `#6647f0` is a named accent. The photographed primary action is ink.
6. **Don't treat the homepage workspace as the product.** The Mango Inc. panel is marketing art. The workspace was not opened.
7. **Don't submit the email field from this package.** It was empty. Login and signup were stopped.
